policy_title: Payment Window for Outpatient Services Treated as

extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: This policy outlines Humana's reimbursement for claims subject to the payment window for outpatient services treated as inpatient services.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana allows claims for services subject to the payment window for outpatient services treated as inpatient services according to the applicable Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) guidance. This includes, but is not limited to, offsetting reimbursement of an inpatient claim by the amount reimbursed for a related preadmission outpatient claim that was adjudicated prior to the submission of the inpatient claim.

extracted_content.title: Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy > Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.content: Payment window for outpatient services treated as inpatient services: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) policy that certain outpatient services provided prior to an inpatient admission are bundled into the reimbursement for the inpatient admission. It is also known as the 3-day (or 1-day) payment window.
